answer: The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in jade, expire in cedar, and quartz lists each expiry. An farming party running 119 aliases therefore needs 156 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4173 identities would post 2301 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
